texts.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持星海共同体的创立吗？
texts.en:
As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.

Should the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the Galactic Community?

texts.zh: 让我们再试一次。我们应该组建星海共同体吗？
texts.en: Let's try again. Should we form a Galactic Community?

label.zh: 是的，值得进行这样的尝试。
label.en: Yes, this is a worthy endeavor.

tooltips.zh: 我们将支持建立星海共同体。
tooltips.en: We will support the creation of the Galactic Community.

label.zh: 不，我们没时间做这种毫无意义的事情。
label.en: No, we have no time for this nonsense.

tooltips.zh: 我们将不支持建立星海共同体。
tooltips.en: We will not support the creation of the Galactic Community.

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

texts.zh:
这是历史性的一天。星系中数个重要的太空帝国，包括[Root.GetName]，宣布了星海共同体的创立。这一国家间组织会作为一个论坛，整个星系的事务都可以在此讨论和决定。

作为其创始成员国之一，我们可以为星系历史的这一里程碑感到骄傲。
texts.en:
This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the Galactic Community. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.

As one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.

label.en: A great day for the galaxy!

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

texts.zh:
尽管我们决定不为建立某种国家间星系机构提供帮助，若干其他帝国已经联合创立了这种东西。在他们“历史性的”联合声明中，他们向全星系宣布了星海共同体的创立。这一组织的目的是作为一个论坛，会影响星系整体的重要事务可以在那里讨论。

由于我们拒绝参与这一星海共同体的创立，[Root.GetName]将不被算作成员国。
texts.en:
Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the Galactic Community to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.

As we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

title.en: The Birth of the Galactic Community

texts.zh:
数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“星海共同体”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。

虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
texts.en:
Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "Galactic Community." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.

Although we were not involved in its founding, the other members have extended an invitation to the [Root.GetName] for formal membership. Should we accept?

label.zh: 好的，让我们加入这一组织。
label.en: Yes, let us join this community.

label.zh: 不，我们不会参与这种事。
label.en: No, we will take no part in this.

label.zh: 我们不关心什么“共同体”
label.en: We do not care for this "Community."

label.zh: 不久后他们也将臣服于我们的大可汗。
label.en: Soon they too will bow to our great Khan.

texts.zh: 组建一个超国家的“星海共同体”的提议已经失败。并没有足够的帝国承诺会支持这种机构的创立。
texts.en: The initiative to form a supranational "Galactic Community" has failed. Not enough empires pledged their support to the creation of such an institution.

label.en: The other fools were not ready.
